title: mutellina adonidifolia var. mutellina
intro: Mutellina adonidifolia var. mutellina, commonly known as Mutellina, is a flowering plant belonging to the Boraginaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mutellina include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
